entry.title: New: Resolution 306 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT WITH THE FEDERAL HIGHWAY ADMINISTRATION AND/OR THE STATE OF HAWAI‘I DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION

Allows for the receipt of $249,320 in federally-derived funds to assist the Department of Public Works in developing Safe Routes to School initiatives to promote walking and biking as safe and viable sources of transportation near schools.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 306-23 & FC-95 - 11/01/23
